Dear Sir, 
 
Sub:- Audio Link of PCBL Results Conference Call for Q1 FY 27 
 
Further to our letter dated 24th July, 2026, we write to inform to you that the Audio Link of the Q1FY27 
Results Conference Call held on Wednesday, 29th July, 2026 at 17:00 hrs India Time, for the quarter ended 
30th June, 2026 has been made available on the website of the company and can be accessed at the link:
